cmd:
export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
{
echo "TIMER_ENABLED: $(systemctl is-enabled expeditor-direct-sync.timer 2>&1)"
echo "TIMER_NEXT: $(systemctl show -p NextElapseUSecRealtime --value expeditor-direct-sync.timer)"
echo "TRIGGER_ACTIVE: $(systemctl is-active deals-sync-trigger.service)"
echo "TRIGGER_RUNS: $(grep -c 'expeditor_direct_sync' /root/deals_trigger.py)"
echo "BAK: $(ls /root/deals_trigger.py.bak-0730 2>&1)"
echo "LOG_TAIL:"; tail -3 /root/direct-sync/sync.log
} | iconv -f utf-8 -t utf-8 -c
